subject: Citrine Labs — vendor registration, PO/mapping, VAT/remit clarifications
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: 2025-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Citrine Labs — vendor registration kickoff / PO field mapping

Team —

Citrine (prospect -> pilot) asked us to self-register as a vendor in their AP portal before the kickoff. Asked for the following items in the initial intake:
- Legal entity full name, remit address, VAT number (EU), tax form (W-9 for US)
- Bank remit instructions + sample invoice PDF
- Primary billing contact and AP contact info
- Invoice header and PO matching fields: they require vendor_id, PO number (exact match), invoice date, net amount and VAT split where applicable

Action items for this thread:
1) Karthik — please confirm which legal entity name we should submit for Citrine (we have two variants on corporate record).
2) Marcus — can you generate a single-line remit CSV (remit_instructions.csv) with our bank name, IBAN, SWIFT, and sample beneficiary reference for PO matching? Their portal accepts CSV upload for bank test.
3) Laura — given this is EU taxable, do we have an EU VAT self-cert that covers the model for pilot invoices (software services)? See attached draft (EU_VAT_SelfCert_Redwood.pdf).

I'm attaching the Redwood AP onboarding packet (v2) that includes our preferred invoice template and sample invoice. Once we confirm the legal name and the remit CSV, I'll register in their portal and follow up with Citrine's vendor ops team.

Attachments: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v2.pdf (PDF), EU_VAT_SelfCert_Redwood.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@citrinelabs.com>

Date: 2025-08-11T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Citrine Labs — vendor registration kickoff / PO field mapping

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the packet. A few quick clarifications from our side before you register:
1) Vendor portal link: https://vendor.citrinelabs.com/register — please use the company tax ID field for VAT; if you don't have an EU VAT we accept a self-certificate for reverse charge (PDF).
2) PO matching: our system does exact-string matching on the PO number (field PO_NUMBER). If your invoices include hyphens or prefixes, please include both the raw PO and a PO_REFERENCE custom field.
3) Currency: payments default to EUR for EU entities; we can pay USD for US-based vendor bank accounts but that requires explicit remit currency selection in the portal.
4) Test ACH/SEPA: we can schedule a micro-remit test after the vendor record is created — email AP (amit.patel@citrinelabs.com) with the vendor_id and preferred test amount.

Also attaching their internal vendor intake checklist for reference (see inline). Let me know when you submit and we'll fast-track verification.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement — Citrine Labs
elena.rossi@citrinelabs.com

Elena —

Thanks for the clear note and portal link. Quick updates:
- Legal entity: use "Redwood Inference, Inc." (exact string) for the vendor registration — Karthik confirmed.
- Bank remit CSV: Marcus attached remit_instructions.csv (one-line, IBAN + SWIFT + reference). Marcus, please confirm the beneficiary reference is: REDWOOD-PO-{PO_NUMBER}.
- VAT: we do not currently have an EU VAT registration; Laura has confirmed the self-cert covers B2B reverse-charge where applicable — attaching EU_VAT_SelfCert_Redwood.pdf.
- Invoice format: we will include both PO_NUMBER and PO_REFERENCE fields. For systems that strip punctuation, we'll include a second line in the invoice header: PO_NUMBER_RAW (digits only).

Attachment stubs: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v2.pdf (contains sample invoice), remit_instructions.csv (CSV), EU_VAT_SelfCert_Redwood.pdf, W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf

Primary billing contact: Soojin Lee — revenueops@redwood.inference — +1 415-555-0192

Invoice delivery: PDF upload + email to ap@citrinelabs.com

Please review the sample invoice in the packet; Marcus, Laura — flag if anything needs to change before I hit submit (I'll do the submission from the account team).

Onwards,
Soojin

Vendor record created. Vendor ID: CL-V-76214.
Next steps:
1) Please upload your remit_instructions.csv to the vendor portal under Bank Details -> Upload.
